t.E1517.agn: In 1976 JECFA set the ADI as 'not specified'.
t.E1517.body: Glycerol diacetate is expected to be rapidly broken down into glycerol and acetate by enzymes in the digestive tract and tissues, and these are expected to be fully used by the body.
t.E1517.found.0: Carrier in flavourings (E 1505, E 1517, E 1518 and E 1520 combined, up to 3,000 mg/kg in food from all sources)
t.E1517.prod: Produced by esterifying citric acid or glycerol through a chemical reaction.
t.E1517.summary: A carrier produced from glycerol and acetic acid. It is used as a solvent in flavourings.
t.E1517.what: A carrier solvent formed by esterifying glycerol with acetic acid (diacetin).
